summary.text: David Daniels is the Republican candidate for Wisconsin State Assembly District 53 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Becky Nichols and independent Rachael Dowling in a race with no incumbent.
His campaign website describes him as an Air Force veteran and business owner who has lived in Neenah since 1993.

paragraphs.text: Daniels's campaign website says he built a career in radon mitigation and environmental safety and now owns Radon Safe Homes and Compassion Homes.
It says he sold a previous company, Radon Specialists of WI, in 2019.
It also says he served on the national board of the American Association of Radon Scientists and Technologists, including as vice president and president.

The site lists his priorities as addressing rising costs, including property taxes, healthcare price transparency and protection for those with pre-existing conditions, and giving parents information and options on their children's education.
